Messages.Author: Scott Marcellus
Messages.Body:
Can Optional Presses and maneuvers be used on a future combat?
For example, can someone play the superior version of flash to
maneuver, their opponent use a press to continue combat, and hold onto
the optional press for the next combat or must the optional press be
used in that round of combat? I imagine the answer to the above
question would hold for optional maneuvers.

Messages.Author: REF
Messages.Body:
ha...@shadow.net (Scott Marcellus) wrote:




They must be for that combat and that round unless they specify combat
such as from equipment or retainers.
You can't play a flash and use either the maneuver or the press for a
later round.
Maneuver for this round and press to continue/end on this round.
Rory

Page 46 of the Vtes rules.
"If a combat card played by a minion has a maneuver as part of the
cards effect, then the maneuver can only be performed during the round
of combat in which the card is played. If a combat card reads
"optional maneuver" as part of its effect, then the minion may
decline to perform the maneuver.

Note that this is for combat cards and action and reactions like the
ones you mentioned are specifically not included.
The press section does not mention it.

The Jhyad rules are very similar but I don't have any of those
booklets available right now.
Rory

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
If a combat card provides an optional press or maneuver, that press
or maneuver must be used during the current round, or not at all.

If a card played outside of combat gives an optional press or maneuver during
a given combat (e.g., Bum's Rush, Rats' Warning), you may use the press or
maneuver during any round of the combat, unless of course the effect indicates
otherwise.
